alerts.reason: Big Lots’ consolidated net sales decline narrowed from 11.36% in July to 3.07% in October, supporting a forecast that the intervening quarter stays above −5.00%. October comparable sales fell 4.7% while inventory rose 17.3% (B, C). That buildup raises the risk of markdowns in the quarter beginning January 30, enough to push the consolidated decline back to 5.00% or more.

Barnes & Noble Education’s consolidated sales growth slowed from 18.03% in July to 5.29% in October (A), leaving room for the intervening quarter to stay above −5.00%. The target quarter laps the April 4, 2021 sale of logo merchandise inventory to FLC (C). If that sale contributed materially to year-ago reported net sales, its absence could push target-quarter sales down at least 5.00%.
